html:
Bai Tu Long Bay Cruise will take you to the islands, including many small islands and people living on the islands, surrounded by limestone ranges with beautiful scenery that looks like Ha Long Bay.

If you are a person who loves peaceful natural scenery, experience the cruise to visit Bai Tu Long Bay, which has its own wild beauty, this place is very suitable for resort tours during your holidays.

Experience Bai Tu Long Bay cruise, you will start from Hon Gai, northeast of Ha Long Bay, then go through Bai Chay bridge, sitting on the cruise you will admire the poetic scenery.

Currently, Ha Long cruise tours all depart from Hanoi, then visitors often choose to stay overnight on the cruise and then visit Bai Tu Long Bay.

For cruise schedules in addition to other locations, visitors do not have to depart from Hanoi, visitors need to choose the time to match the boat’s departure time.

The cruise itinerary departs from Hanoi as follows: Hanoi, tourists take Highway 5 to Bac Ninh, Highway 18 Pha Lai – Chi Linh – Dong Trieu – Uong Bi – Ha Long – Hon Gai / or Noi Bai – Bac Ninh, Highway 18A through Pha Lai – Sao Do – Dong Trieu – Uong Bi – Ha Long – Hon Gai, the distance you take is 4 hours to reach the bay.

Or you can choose the itinerary Hanoi – Hai Phong – Ha Long – Hon Gai with the same distance and time. However, if you take the highway, it will save you some time to visit.

The itinerary to Bai Tu Long Bay for 2 days and 1 night, please refer to it before having the opportunity to set foot here.

Day 1: You will depart from Hanoi to Hon Gai port, Ha Long city, go to the cruise waiting room, check in to board the ship.

On board, you will be given safety instructions, then check in, enjoy lunch and rest.

In the afternoon, depending on the ship’s schedule, you can join kayaking or bamboo boating with fishermen to visit the islands and see the scenery.

At the end of the day, you will return to the boat to rest or join a cooking class with the cruise’s professional chefs.

In the evening, having dinner on the boat and freely admiring the scenery from the deck will bring you the most unforgettable moments.

Day 2:

In the morning, you wake up early to admire the scenery from the boat, a fresh air of the sea and islands. Then enjoy breakfast and visit Thien Canh Son cave, one of the natural caves in Bai Tu Long Bay.

Return to the ship to check out, the boat takes you back to the mainland, before returning to the mainland you will have a light lunch on the boat, then take you back to Hon Gai, the car takes you back to the original pick-up point to end the 2-day 1-night Bai Tu Long tour.

The journey will bring you an exciting vacation, you will have the most interesting experiences in the island paradise during your vacation.

So if you are choosing a vacation, choose the Bai Tu Long Bay cruise tour today to experience the most interesting things, when sitting on a cruise gliding through the famous sights, or experience soaking in the cool water right on a 5-star cruise, enjoying delicious and attractive dishes, learning to cook with a professional chef will bring you the most enjoyable feeling during your vacation.
